description: Manage your Optus Business Mobile Broadband connection on the Microsoft Windows 8 platform, view your mobile broadband account session data usage and data usage history, send and receive SMS messages, access Optus Business online services, access contact information for Optus Business support and manage custom mobile connection profiles. Application Requirements: Application requires an Internet Connection and an active Optus Business mobile service to function correctly as this application is intended for Optus Business customers only.
